name: Elderberry
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO patients due to low FODMAP content, but consume in moderation as with all fruits during active symptoms.
preparationTips: Cook elderberries before eating - raw berries can cause digestive upset
Remove stems and leaves completely as they contain toxic compounds
Use in jams, syrups, or baked goods for better digestibility
Strain cooked elderberries to remove seeds if sensitive to fiber
